Gateway refuses public http:// in its constructor before any client exists; for private-LAN http:// it sends only GET /System/Info/Public, then refuses login and every Quick Connect call until confirmUnencryptedConnection() stores {serverId, origin} (fluster.lanHttpConfirmations, no secrets). Gateway Axios uses the fetch adapter with maxRedirects 0; 3xx is an error (gateway-redirects.test.ts proves no request reaches the redirect target). Rust media and socket URLs use the same classes (ws:// only where http:// is allowed); libmpv starts with stream-lavf-o=max_redirects=0 and ytdl=no after FFmpeg http.c was shown to resend custom headers to a cross-origin redirect target (checked with mpv 0.41.0/FFmpeg 9.0.2).
